data.name: Noemina
data.gender_notes: Noemina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'Na'amah' and Greek 'Nome', meaning 'pleasantness' and 'name of the goddess', respectively. In the Bible, Noemia (Noemah) is the wife of Boaz and the mother of Obed, who was a direct descendant of Jesse and the ancestor of King David. The name Noemina carries the meaning “Comfort in God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Noemina usually hope their child will grow to embody comfort in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and faith in God.
data.etymology: Noemina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comfort in God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noemina total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
